{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Red knit top, slim-cut crew neck sweater, hip length, red (#B22234), soft merino-blend knit
Dark straight-leg jeans, high waist, full length to the ankle, indigo (#1F2A44), stretch denim
Light trench coat, single-breasted, knee length, camel (#C19A6B), cotton gabardine
Ankle boots, low block heel, almond toe, dark brown (#4A2F23), smooth leather
Leather shoulder bag, structured medium size, dark brown (#4A2F23), smooth leather
Thin scarf, long rectangle loosely draped, cream (#F2EAD8), light wool
Small gold hoop earrings, gold (#C9A227), polished metal

This outfit works because the red sweater gives you the red top you asked for and stays the clear focus against calm, neutral colors. Dark jeans and brown boots keep the look relaxed and neat, right for meeting friends over coffee or lunch. The camel trench and cream scarf add warmth and light layering for an autumn day without competing with the red. The gold hoops add a small touch of polish while the whole look stays easy and comfortable."}
